title: TorusGuardFindingLifecycle
description: State machine transition and lifecycle validation schema for TorusGuard v0.5.0.

required_artifacts.description: Artifacts that must exist before advancing to the next stage.

Detect.default: Locate candidate security weakness in source code, configuration, or environment.

Classify.default: Normalize finding with Rule ID, taxonomy category, severity, and initial confidence level.

Verify.default: Validate evidence sufficiency and reachable data flow; downgrade to Needs Review if unproven.

Remediate.default: Formulate least-invasive, framework-native code modification with before/after diffs.

Recheck.default: Execute differential re-audit on post-remediation codebase to assert finding resolution.

Archive.default: Preserve verification evidence and timestamp in audit trail record for compliance/auditability.
